lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice partial agreement before giving a different view.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Discussing phone rules during a course, meeting, or shared activity.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Agreeing partly, adding a contrast, and keeping the tone polite.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss whether phones should be put away during a Swedish course activity.

main_focus.name: partial agreement with jag håller delvis med, men
main_focus.description: Acknowledge another viewpoint before adding a contrasting argument or limitation.
model_examples: Jag håller delvis med, men alla använder mobilen på olika sätt.
Det stämmer till viss del, samtidigt behöver vi kunna fokusera.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use partial-agreement frames naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: V2 after samtidigt and till viss del

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Prioritize reusable disagreement chunks and practical classroom/activity vocabulary.

dialogue_shape.opening: A proposed phone rule is introduced with one initial opinion.
dialogue_shape.middle: They partly agree, raise a limitation, and suggest a compromise.
dialogue_shape.ending: They settle on a balanced rule or next step.

target_complexity.repetition: partial-agreement phrases should recur without becoming a scripted debate

focus: the rule or proposal being discussed

sentence_focus: one sentence with jag håller delvis med
one sentence adding a contrast with samtidigt
one sentence naming a reasonable exception
one sentence explaining why a rule helps
